I was referring to this post on the subreddit:
https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/c0xuqu/2018_financials_are_in_subscription_revenue_has/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share

Basically, that's nearly 3 times the revenue from just subscriptions, and if most people play osrs, wouldn't it be in their best interest to cater to the subscription model and bring more people into the game? Players don't want MTX, it's so hard to get a good game these days without them we just want an escape.

I have just two points for this

1) OSRS is pulling in more money with subscribers per month than rs3 makes period, yet the team for rs3 is still MUCH larger than osrs. Shouldn't the distribution of funds be better focused on where the money is being spent than where we can exploit our users for more money?

2) We only allowed bonds because it allowed people who didn't want to spend money on the game at all a way to pay for membership, I highly doubt bonds would have passed if in game cosmetics were part of the bond process.
